sections.title: Operational Readiness
sections.description: Operational readiness needs coordinated planning, explicit handoff ownership, and dependable review cadence to keep execution stable under changing constraints.

sections.title: Data Reliability
sections.description: Reliability improves when anomaly detection, triage workflows, and refresh governance are consistently enforced across all reporting dependencies.

sections.title: Stakeholder Alignment
sections.description: Alignment quality increases when status updates include decision context, dependency impact, and measurable follow-up actions for each workstream.
